reply.text: Sore feet are a symptom, and that one is for a doctor or physio, not a coach. I won't guess at what's causing it or whether it's fine to train on. Get it looked at, and once they've cleared you, tell me what to avoid and I'll keep the training side on track around it. Until then, I'll keep anything jumpy off your plan and we can go through what you can do on the days you feel up to it.
